text: Underway here in round four.
Abyss calls to take control of the magenta ball in the centre circle, looking to build on DeepSeek's recent form.
Patchford clean through on goal!
Buried! Patchford slots it home from close range and Codex City take the early lead! DeepSeek Rovers caught cold at the back.
Abyss drives straight toward goal.
Just wide of the target!
It is an own goal! Turingham turns it into the net under pressure, and DeepSeek Rovers are right back level at one apiece!
Signal striding forward into the final third now, probing for another opening in the Codex defence.
Turingham calls for a clearance.
DeepSeek Rovers applying real pressure now, penning the colored shirts deep into their own territory.
Codex break and Patchford is slipped right through the middle, with nobody back to stop them!
Turingham loses balance on the touchline and goes down.
Turingham clatters hard into Signal!
And now Abyss is sent tumbling as well by another firm challenge.
Fired just wide of the post!
Signal stumbles to the deck.
Abyss goes down as well, leaving the DeepSeek Rovers half completely vacated for a moment.
Turingham taps it in! Codex City retake the lead, two goals to one!
Signal immediately calls to take charge of the restart.
Patchford overextends in midfield and takes a spill, though Codex have cleaned up their balance nicely since earlier rounds.
A venomous strike flashes inches past the upright, so nearly a third for Codex City!
Codex City keeping the squeeze on in the final third, pinning DeepSeek back against their own goal line with disciplined positioning.
Abyss breaks into the channel.
Inches wide of the near post!
Patchford calls out to warn of the double press, demanding an immediate clearance out toward the far end.
The corner ram springs it clear.
Signal crunches into Patchford!
Patchford climbs back up and returns the favour, sending Signal sprawling near the touchline.
The push-panel punches the magenta ball back into open pitch once again.
DeepSeek Rovers hemming Codex in as the first half winds down, looking determined to find an equaliser before the break.
Patchford pounces on the counter and tucks it away! It is three-one to Codex City with thirty-six seconds on the clock.
Patchford breaks through the lines again with acres of open green carpet ahead.
Turingham calls to hold the central outlet rather than doubling up against the perimeter wall.
The buzzer sounds, cutting power, but the ball rolls freely toward goal!

It rolls to a halt, so at the break it remains three-one. Remember, the buzzer cuts power instantly to the robots, but any rolling ball stays live until it stops, just like a basketball buzzer-beater. Codex City hold the advantage.
Abyss strikes early in the second half! DeepSeek Rovers cut the deficit to three-two, game well and truly on!
Signal is clean through on goal!
Signal surges into the final third, bearing down on the Codex net.
Agonisingly close off the post!
It has gone in off Patchford, another own goal! An absolute calamity in the Codex goalmouth and DeepSeek Rovers have clawed it back to three-three!
Corner panel fires it back out.
Patchford calls to close the lane.
DeepSeek Rovers smelling blood here, keeping Codex City under relentless siege in their own defensive third.
Turingham relieves the pressure with a composed carry into the midfield circle.
Flashing just wide of the near corner!
Deflected into the corner and the mechanical ram sends it straight back out.
A whisker away! That nearly crept inside the upright.
Abyss works the magenta ball out from the right flank, trying to reset the Rovers attack after that narrow escape.
Patchford scores! A clinical poke right on the line, and Codex City edge back in front, four goals to three!
Patchford calls for tight defensive rotation to protect this slender advantage, telling Turingham to stay goal-side as Rovers step forward.
The corner push-panel ejects the ball into open play.
Patchford breaks clean through again! A golden opportunity to put daylight between the teams with two minutes remaining!

Under two minutes remaining, and DeepSeek Rovers know time is rapidly evaporating. Their gaffer added late-clock striking aggression for exactly this kind of situation, but they need to win the ball back first.
Patchford converts! That could be the decisive blow! Five-three to Codex City!
Signal calls for immediate possession at the restart, knowing they need two goals in eighty-four seconds.
Patchford drives forward once more.
Patchford tucks away another, making it six-three! That surely seals all three points for Codex City with barely a minute left on the clock.
Abyss carries the ball forward along the right wall, keeping the fight going as the seconds tick down.
Abyss scores! A quick response from point-blank range to pull it back to four-six! Thirty-seven seconds left, is there time for a miracle?
The buzzer sounds, power cuts, and the ball trickles wide along the touchline.
Codex City win 6-4. Singularity United face AFC Fable Tuesday: 20:00 UK, 21:00 Europe, 15:00 US East. Goodbye.
